execution_mode: campaign script -> production entrypoint webpent.cli.unified_hunt.run_unified_hunt (no_llm=True, auto_approve=True)

request_budget.note: CLI standard-mode preset budgets; the enforced request surface is proven by the lab request log

redaction: cookies/session values redacted in the recorded copy (synthetic lab credentials); the run itself used the real values
final_state_source: graph.get_state(config) — the actual final graph state (reducer-applied), read while the run context was open

drops_explained: open hypotheses but zero confirmed findings: normal for a running campaign (confirmation requires the CausalGuard authority chain); if persistent, check validator coverage and budget exhaustion

notes: the funnel is computed from the AUTHORITATIVE final state (graph.get_state) — the tee'd last-write merge survives only as an explicitly labeled fallback
requests logged by the lab itself prove the safety invariants from the run, not from expectations
